chunks: Al-Hasan ibn Muhammad ibn Yahya al-Alavi (may God be pleased with him) narrated to us, saying: My grandfather narrated to me, saying: Al-Husayn ibn Muhammad narrated to us, saying: Ibn Abi al-Sari narrated to us, saying: Hisham ibn Muhammad ibn al-Sa'ib narrated to us, from his father, from Abu Salih, from Ibn Abbas.

He said: There was a difference of ten years between Talib and Aqeel, and between Aqeel and Ja'far ten years, and between Ja'far and Ali (peace be upon him) ten years, and Ali (peace be upon him) was the youngest of them.

key_terms.جَعْفَر: Ja'far, son of Ali ibn Abi Talib
key_terms.طَالِب: Talib, son of Ali ibn Abi Talib
key_terms.عَقِيل: Aqeel, son of Ali ibn Abi Talib

ai.seo_question: What is the age difference between the four brothers of the Prophet Muhammad?
ai.summary: This narration from al-Khisal clarifies the precise generational timeline of the Prophet’s sons, establishing a ten-year interval between each brother, which places Ali (AS) as the youngest and highlights his unique position as the last son born to Fatima bint Asad. This chronological detail is significant in Shia scholarship for understanding the succession of leadership and the distinct roles each brother played during the early Meccan and Medinan periods. It underscores the continuity of prophetic lineage and the gradual emergence of the key figures who would support the Prophet’s mission.
